_comment: Auto job-fetcher preferences. Set these in the board's 'Agent' settings panel, OR copy this file to ./config.json (same folder) and edit by hand. agent/config.json is gitignored, so your personal preferences never get committed.

schedule._comment: 24h local time and which weekdays to run. Default is Mon-Fri.

location._comment: modes: any of 'remote', 'hybrid', 'onsite'. base: city used for hybrid/onsite searches.

sources._comment: use_cowork_connectors only applies when run inside Claude Cowork. pluggable_api_keys lets you add your own job-board API adapters (see agent/sources/). If none are configured, the runner falls back to Claude web search.

notes: Prefer direct ATS links (greenhouse.io, lever.co, ashbyhq.com, or company careers pages) over aggregators. Tag venture-backed startups with the 'startup' tag.
